title: Buggy Samsung using workaround
body: What does the message “Buggy Samsung using workaround” in the G5 system status mean? Is this configurable? Does it relate in any way to missed readings?

comments.body: It means a work-around is being applied to get around Samsung power saving features which are not compliant with the android specification. It is not configurable, it automatically enables when required.

Xdrip ha dejado de funcionar y me aparece este mensaje "Buggy Samsung: Using work around".
Puede ser el motivo del fallo de la aplicación?
